name: gw2-wardrobe-expansions
description: Buckets GW2 wardrobe skins (armor/weapon/back/gathering) by the expansion or release that introduced them, using the official GW2 API cross-referenced with GW2 Wiki category data.

scripts.all: npm run fetch:skins && npm run fetch:wiki && npm run build && npm run fetch:dates && npm run fetch:dates:weightclass && npm run report:eras && npm run build:web && npm run build:docs
